app.name: SenseOrbit
app.tagline: Draw your farm boundary and get soil, weather & satellite insights — powered by accredited APIs.

login.subtitle: Enter your 4-character DIF code to sign in and view your farm scans
login.invalidCode: Invalid DIF Code. Please check your 4-character code and try again.
login.networkError: Could not verify DIF code. Please check your connection.

map.title: Draw Your Farm Boundary
map.subtitle: Use the polygon tool on the map to outline your field. Tap each corner, then close the shape.
map.locationDenied: Location access denied. You can still search or draw manually.
map.drawHint: Tap the polygon tool, then tap corners of your farm on the map.
map.invalidPolygon: Your boundary crosses itself. Please fix it before generating a report.
map.noPolygon: Draw a farm boundary on the map first.
map.polygonTooSmall: The drawn area is too small. Please draw a larger boundary.

report.title: Farm Scan & Agronomic Report
report.error: Could not load report data. Please try again.

soil.title: Soil Analysis
soil.errorMessage: The soil information service (ISRIC SoilGrids) is currently slow, down, or timed out. Please try again later.

ph.acidic: Your soil is acidic — consider lime application.
ph.neutral: Your soil pH is in the neutral range — good for most crops.
ph.alkaline: Your soil is alkaline — monitor micronutrient availability.

texture.clay: Clay-heavy soil — holds water well but may need drainage.
texture.sandy: Sandy soil — drains quickly; add organic matter.
texture.silty: Silty soil — fertile but can compact when wet.
texture.clayLoam: Clay loam — a balanced, productive soil type.
texture.loamySand: Loamy sand — easy to work but needs regular irrigation.
texture.loam: Loam — an ideal balance of sand, silt, and clay.

organic.low: Organic matter is low — consider compost or green manure.
organic.high: Organic matter is good — supports soil health.
